'''Doleth Arnoko''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Rebel trooper/Legends|soldier]] who used to work as a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]].

He settled on [[Trivar II]] and worked as an informant, but fled from the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] to [[Glare Peak]], where he was recruited into a cell led by [[Jaxon Brand]].

Trained as a [[Commando/Legends|commando]], he believed that the Rebel soldiers could beat [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] soldiers and that peace could only be found once the Empire fell.

At Glare Peak, he was assigned a [[Rescue at Glare Peak|rescue operation]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Doleth is one of the pre-generated characters from the [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Beta|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Beta]]. He was then used as one of the pre-generated characters in [[Fantasy Flight Games]] special promotion, ''[[Rescue at Glare Peak]]''.
